description: Exact counts for a text: characters (with and without spaces, emoji counted as one), words, sentences, paragraphs, lines, UTF-8 bytes, plus reading and speaking time. Language models see text as tokens and miscount — never estimate counts or check length limits yourself; call this tool. Works for any language, including Chinese, Japanese, Arabic and Turkish.

locale.description: BCP 47 language tag such as "en", "tr" or "ja" for language-specific word rules.

name: count_text
title: Count words and characters exactly
